chunks: When he drew near, a voice called out to him from the tree on the blessed spot on the right side of the valley: "O Moses, I am verily God, the Lord of all the worlds."

key_terms.الْوَادِي الْأَيْمَنِ: the right side of the valley

ai.seo_question: Where did God speak to Prophet Moses from?
ai.summary: This verse marks the pivotal moment of Musa's (AS) divine commissioning, where God addresses him from a blessed spot on the right side of the valley, specifically identified in Shia exegesis as the location of the burning bush. The declaration 'I am Allah, the Lord of the Worlds' establishes the foundational monotheism (Tawhid) that underpins the prophetic mission, emphasizing God's direct authority and presence in guiding His chosen servant.
